verdict.rationale: Cursor's CLI has a documented print/headless mode explicitly for CI pipelines and scripts (--print, --force, non-interactive API key auth), machine-readable JSON/stream-json output formats, and a first-class GitHub Actions recipe. This is corroborated by live probes confirming the docs and API endpoints actually resolve. Missing for 10: independent (non-vendor) hands-on report of someone running it successfully in a real CI pipeline.
